title: Diagnose: skhd, Ghostty global quick-term, and kindaVim global hotkeys all dead
description: All skhd keymaps stopped working (alt-a, alt-r, everything). Ghostty quick terminal (ctrl-`) only works when Ghostty is focused (used to be global). kindaVim (ctrl-c) doesn't work anywhere. homerow (cmd-;/cmd-') still works. Already restarted skhd and yabai services with no effect. Suspect stale macOS Accessibility/Input-Monitoring grants (post brew/OS update) and/or Karabiner intercepting ctrl/alt. Diagnose root cause before applying any fix.
notes: CORRECTED DIAGNOSIS (subagent's upgrade advice was wrong): Root cause = Secure Keyboard Entry blocking CGEventTaps (skhd/kindaVim/Ghostty global hotkey); homerow survives via Carbon hotkeys. Ghostty 1.3.1 is already latest (brew shows no update) - DO NOT rely on upgrade. ghostty +show-config confirms macos-auto-secure-input=false IS loaded, so NO Ghostty config change needed. Live SKE holder verified = Firefox PID 2088. Ghostty tops cumulative skhd-log count (305x) but via PID 2207 running since May 21, predating Jun 2 config update = historical. FIX: (1) quit Firefox to release live lock; (2) fully restart Ghostty so the 18-day-old instance reloads verified config; no reboot, no config edit.

title: Persist markdown wrap toggle per buffer for current Neovim session
description: Fix markdown wrap behavior so the user toggle persists for the toggled buffer/window state during the current Neovim session instead of being reset by BufWinEnter defaults.

title: Align zellij + tmux keymaps to default tmux (Ctrl-b prefix)
description: Switch zellij unlock key and tmux prefix from Ctrl-g to default Ctrl-b so bare/default tmux on remote servers matches muscle memory. Keep all custom functionality. Zellij: retarget unlock to Ctrl-b, send-literal Ctrl-b, remove conflicting lock bind; add tmux-mnemonic binds ([ scroll, % / " splits in pane mode, d detach in normal). Tmux: remove Ctrl-g prefix override (revert to default Ctrl-b), restore prefix , to rename-window with which-key moved to Space, make % / " splits open in current path.

title: Persist wrap per buffer for all filetypes in Neovim session
description: Generalize the current wrap persistence behavior so window-local wrap is remembered per buffer across buffer/window switches for all filetypes during the current Neovim session, while preserving markdown default wrap=false behavior.

title: Survey Obsidian.nvim and Obsidian CLI builtin capabilities for chezmoi Neovim config
description: Review current custom obsidian.nvim behavior against the latest upstream changelog and produce a markdown report covering where builtins or Obsidian CLI commands can replace or improve custom commands/functions.
